text:
sam (Hiring Manager): Heads-up — we have a new hire (Priya) joining on Mon. Can we get a compact first-week runbook + a simple 30/60/90 sketch that I can share with her? Need checklist for access, intro meetings, and manager expectations.
alyssa (People Ops): Yup — can do. I’ll drop a short day-by-day and a 3-step 30/60/90 you can tailor. Any special access needs? GPU infra? VPN only?
sam (Hiring Manager): No GPU to start. Standard webapp role + some infra read access. Would like: 1) accounts provisioned day 0, 2) 1:1 with me + onboarding buddy day1, 3) product deep-dive day2.
alyssa (People Ops): Got it. Drafting checklist now. Quick preview: Day 0 = accounts + laptop + access checks; Day 1 = orientation + 1:1 + buddy intro; Day 2 = product + infra walkthrough; rest of week = small tasks + meetings to meet team. I’ll paste more in a sec.
jordan (IT): I can pre-enroll Priya in our system and ship the laptop. Prefer MacBook Air 16" or MacBook Pro? Also will create these groups: engineers, infra-read, docs-edit. If you want the laptop delivered to SF office or home, tell me.
sam (Hiring Manager): Home delivery to SF office address is fine. MacBook Air is okay. Please add her to infra-read and engineers.
jordan (IT): Cool. I’ll queue the device and pre-create accounts tomorrow morning. For account provisioning, please fill this short form: <https://intra.redwood/provision-request>. If you want to use the CLI:
```
redwood-ops provision --user priya.s --groups engineers,infra-read --device mac-air
```
alyssa (People Ops): Pasting the compact first-week runbook (one-pager style):
- Day 0 (prestart): confirm delivery, ID docs, onboarding paperwork (HR), invite to Slack, add to Zoom/Google, SSO enrollment.
- Day 1 (welcome): 9:30 intro with People Ops (expectations, benefits), 11:00 manager 1:1, 2:00 buddy sync, 4:00 quick goals chat.
- Day 2 (product): 10:00 product walkthrough, 1:00 infra overview, 3:00 reading time + small starter task.
- Day 3-5: shadowing, first PR pairing, security & compliance training, lunch with team.
- Deliverable by EOW: open PR for a tiny bug/fix and write up 3 things learned.
30/60/90 (short):
- 30d: ship first small PR, know codebase layout, complete security training.
- 60d: own a small feature, reliable in cross-team syncs, start owning metrics.
- 90d: lead a minor project, reduce time to merge for own PRs, propose one product improvement.
cesar (Security): Quick add — mandatory 2FA + security intro before any infra creds. Also request for KMS/HSM access needs an approval ticket. I’ll link the training: <https://security.redwood/intro>.
alyssa (People Ops): Also note: payroll + benefits paperwork must be completed by EOD day 0 to avoid delays. Onboard-bot will DM with checklist and links.
onboard-bot: Reminder: new hire paperwork assigned to priya.s. Tasks: I-9, payroll form, SSO invite. Due: 2026-03-23 23:59 PST.
sam (Hiring Manager): One more — can we schedule the 30-min "expectations and feedback cadence" meeting for end of week? I want to set initial goals and check comfort.
alyssa (People Ops): Yes — I’ll slot a 30-min meeting on Friday 4pm and add a lightweight 1-2 pager for manager notes (how to give feedback first 30 days).
jordan (IT): Device + accounts queued. ETA for provisioning: Mon 08:30 PT. I’ll post the device serial here once imaged.
cesar (Security): I’ll run the security checklist with Priya on Day 1 3pm. Will keep it <30 min.
sam (Hiring Manager): Awesome — thanks all. If anyone needs Priya's personal email for delivery, DM me. :thumbsup:
alyssa (People Ops): Sending the final one-pager + 30/60/90 doc in #new-hires and attaching to Priya's profile. :rocket: 
onsupertiny-note: keep replies short so I can forward to manager handbook.
